build_SpectralNetwork: build a SpectralNetwork to diagonalize a linear operator using a neural network with custom gradients
create_LaplacianOperator: create a LaplacianOperator that approximates the Laplacian of a network output via finite differences
run_SpectralNetwork_train: run the training loop of a SpectralNetwork to minimize the sum of eigenvalues of the objective
build_ExactLaplacianOperator: build an ExactLaplacianOperator that computes the exact Laplacian of a network output using tf.gradients
test_covariance_custom_gradient: test the _covariance function that computes sample covariance with a custom gradient implementation
